title: Egg Noodle Stir Fry with Jagged Ethiopian Seasoning
description: A quick and easy stir fry recipe using jagged ethiopian seasoning and crispy noodles. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add onion and garlic and stir-fry until onion is translucent.
Push onion mixture to one side of the pan.
Add a little more oil if necessary, then add the beaten eggs.
Scramble the eggs until they are cooked through, breaking them up into small pieces as they cook.
Mix the eggs with the onion mixture.
Add the noodles, jagged ethiopian seasoning, and chopped crispy noodles to the pan.
Stir-fry everything together for about 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the seasoning.
